notes: Sourced from Blackmagic Design's own official "Product Technical Specifications" PDF for the HyperDeck Studio 12G (Blackmagic-authored document, mirrored/hosted by authorized reseller Full Compass at the sourceUrl since Blackmagic's current live techspecs page no longer lists this discontinued/superseded model — it now only shows current models like HyperDeck Studio 4K Pro). The PDF includes an official rear-panel connector diagram which was used to verify exact port counts and labels. Connections confirmed: 1x SDI In, 1x SDI Loop Through (output), 2x SDI Out (playback), 1x Monitor Out, 1x Ref In (all BNC), 1x HDMI In + 1x HDMI Out (HDMI 2.0 type A), 1x RS-422 remote (DE-9), 1x Ethernet (RJ45), 1x USB 2.0 Mini-B, 1x internal 100-240V AC power supply (IEC inlet). No analog audio, no analog video, and no timecode connector exist on this unit (audio is embedded-only over SDI/HDMI; spec sheet explicitly states "None" for these fields). SDI ports graded sdi-12g reflecting the unit's top-line supported rate (spec lists supported SDI rates as 270Mb/1.5G/3G/6G/12G — all ports are multi-rate capable down to SD). Ethernet link speed not stated in the spec sheet (this is a 2016-era 1RU deck; likely 100M/1G but not confirmed), so grade omitted per instructions. USB connector mapped to closest available enum "usb-micro" since "Mini-B" is not a distinct option in the allowed connector list — physically it is a Mini-B receptacle, not Micro-USB. Two "SDI Out" ports are physically identical/unlabeled duplicates (both silkscreened "SDI Out" per the official diagram) so both share the same name.
